source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with ink-and-color mountains, river/lake spaces, rocky banks, tree groves, small pavilions, bridges, and distant hills; calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_central_rocky_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the main upper central mountain mass: stacked craggy rocks with a high rounded peak, pale ochre washes, gray ink contours, dark texture strokes, and small pines clustered along the summit and ledges. Exclude the surrounding calligraphy above and the lower village/water motifs.
must_preserve: angular ink contour lines defining rock faces
dry-brush cun texture strokes and gray wash granulation
warm ochre planes on cliff shelves
small dark pine crowns and dotted foliage on the ridge
mist-softened lower edges where the mountain meets the valley

motifs.name: right_sweeping_striated_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side diagonal hillside system with long sweeping ridges descending toward the water, including layered ochre-and-gray slopes, dark dotted tree bands, and exposed rock seams. Exclude the waterside houses at the foot and the far-right bamboo grove if possible.
must_preserve: parallel diagonal ridge strokes
alternating pale ochre washes and gray ink shadows
dark stippled vegetation following ridge contours
broken dry-brush rock texture
soft mist gaps between overlapping slopes

motifs.name: distant_left_shore_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the faint low hills and shoreline on the upper-left water horizon, with thin ink outlines, muted gray washes, and small tree clumps near the shore. Avoid seals and blank paper areas above.
must_preserve: very light horizontal ink shoreline
pale gray distant hill silhouettes
small clustered dark trees near the shore
soft fading wash edges suggesting atmospheric distance

motifs.name: central_lakeside_pavilion_spit
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion or roofed structure on the central peninsula beneath the main mountain, with adjacent vertical trees, low rocky bank, and narrow shoreline. Do not include the large mountain behind except immediate supporting rocks and trees.
must_preserve: thin roof geometry and layered eaves
delicate vertical tree trunks beside the building
small dotted foliage and dark leaf clusters
low ochre bank wash
fine ink shoreline and tiny reflections or ripples

motifs.name: mid_left_bridge_and_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left settlement at the lake edge: small roofed huts tucked among trees, a low horizontal bridge or walkway crossing the water, and the adjacent rocky shoreline. Exclude the large foreground grove below and the central mountain above.
must_preserve: fine black roof and wall linework
thin bridge posts and horizontal deck strokes
scattered rocks along the bank
mixed tree trunks, dark foliage dots, and pale washes
short horizontal water ripples under the bridge

motifs.name: mid_right_waterside_houses
motifs.description: Isolate the pair of small houses at the base of the right hills beside the water, including the nearby slender willows/bare trees, short pine rows, and ochre shoreline. Avoid including the full hillside above.
must_preserve: rectangular house walls and neat stacked roof lines
delicate vertical posts and eave strokes
slender willow-like trunks and sparse branches
small dark pine clusters along the bank
brown-ochre ground wash and reflected shoreline marks

motifs.name: lower_left_bamboo_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground grove with a small pavilion nestled among tall bamboo/pine trunks, dense vertical tree screen, rocky base, and layered foreground shrubs. Exclude the red seal at the bottom edge.
must_preserve: tall straight bamboo or pine trunks with fine vertical ink lines
dark needle clusters and stippled foliage
small pavilion roof, railings, and posts hidden among trees
rounded foreground rocks with ochre wash
dry-brush bark texture and varied trunk thicknesses

motifs.name: right_foreground_bamboo_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground rocky bank with tall bamboo and pine-like trees, dark leafy clusters, pale trunks, shrubs, and layered boulders along the water. Exclude the mid-right houses and the large hillside behind.
must_preserve: slender bamboo trunks and segmented vertical strokes
dark clustered leaves and needle-like foliage
rounded ink-outlined boulders with ochre-gray wash
thin shoreline strokes at the water edge
overlapping shrub dots and small branch silhouettes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
